r1_reusable_eligibility.basis: Exact ROM profile and repository verifier are mandatory. Money checks two valid consecutive slots, supported counters/parity, key0, and decoded 0..9999999 values; save SHA is recorded but not used as allowlist. Cycle 2 unseen progressed SHA qualified. Party and Items use independent structural predicates.
r1_reusable_eligibility.fail_closed: Malformed/ambiguous saves, incompatible profile, unsupported key/state/shape and unsupported request reject.

r2_money.basis: Normal GUI target range 0..9999999; bounded byte envelope and postconditions; actual two-cycle Money values loaded and normally saved in exact v0.22.

r2_party.basis: Existing ordinary party members: reusable Friendship across structurally valid records; constrained Move 1 Pound/Tackle replacement; level-5-only Bulbasaur/Ivysaur stat edits with coherent cached stats. Level-6 stat-changing operations fail closed because the exact integrated formula is unresolved. R4 Human-tested Friendship twice. Native game-generated Rattata template record was imported, displayed, healed, used in battle, and normally saved.
r2_party.limits: No generic constructor. Level changes are read-only; EXP is restricted to the level-5 range when the level-5 stat predicate passes. Friendship and Move 1 remain independent of the stat model. No fresh normal-save round trip for stat-changing target output; no exact upstream integration revision claim.

r2_inventory.basis: Reusable Potion x1..3 quantity plus Antidote x1 add/remove in observed slot 2 only when the immutable source has Potion x3, item #533 x1 and zero tail. Local native pre/delete/repurchase snapshots independently verified; API/UI use capability-specific shape checks without save SHA allowlist. R4 verified GUI Potion edit through game normal saves.
r2_inventory.limits: No capacity claim, later-slot compaction, arbitrary item/quantity, other pocket, or Give All. Antidote GUI edit itself has not received a separate editor-output game round trip.

r3_gui.basis: 127.0.0.1-only NiceGUI app; Party/Items/Trainer surfaces; no JSON/hash/offset input; semantic preview, verified separate download, stale-control invalidation, fail-visible rejection, and Advanced details. Existing actual Chromium and simulation evidence verifies composed core/download equality, source/ROM immutability and stale rejection.
